cachyos-arm64ec-dd-turnip.wcfg.name: CachyOS Wine ARM64EC + DD-Turnip, DXVK 3.1.1
cachyos-arm64ec-dd-turnip.wcfg.description: Experimental, not tested on a device yet. CachyOS Wine 11.0 ARM64EC build for Android (downloaded automatically), DD-Turnip v0.1.1 with 4096 MB reported memory and a GTX 1060 name, DXVK 3.1.1 ARM64EC, Box64 0.4.4, alsa audio, 1280x720. BeamNG 0.39 picks the D3D12 backend by default; this config has no VKD3D, so add -gfx dx11 to the game arguments or install VKD3D-Proton.

linux-box64.wcfg.name: Linux container, Box64 0.4.4, Turnip 26.3
linux-box64.wcfg.description: A Linux container (Arch Linux ARM runtime under proot) that runs the Linux build of BeamNG.drive 0.39 through Box64 0.4.4 with the Performance preset. Native (dma-buf) output, 800x600 with FSR 1 upscaling, 3x frame generation (needs your own Lossless.dll), the Steam client started with the container. Needs the Linux runtime, a Linux Turnip driver and Box64 installed from Components; only the settings are imported. Start the game with -nosteam in the shortcut's launch options.

linux-fex.wcfg.name: Linux container, FEX 2610, Turnip 26.3
linux-fex.wcfg.description: A Linux container (Arch Linux ARM runtime under proot) that runs the Linux build of BeamNG.drive 0.39 through FEX 2610 in an Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 root filesystem, with the Vulkan thunk (Turnip 26.3, native output). **Does not work yet**: the game starts and loads, but its menu never appears, because the runtime's proot refuses the game's Chromium helper process (execveat). It is published as a quick way to make a FEX container for programs that start no helper processes; use the Box64 config for BeamNG. Needs the Linux runtime, a Linux Turnip driver, FEX and the root filesystem; they are installed for you after you confirm. FEX runs only from copied files (shared storage is noexec): use the program copy option when adding the program.
